review_candidates.title: Technical Support Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Tabarak focuses on delivering reliable engineering and construction solutions that meet complex project requirements. Day-to-day responsibilities include diagnosing and troubleshooting technical issues, supporting engineering and construction operations, and resolving hardware, software, or systems-related problems. The Technical Support Engineer will collaborate closely with project teams and vendors to maintain system reliability, optimize workflows, and ensure uninterrupted project execution.
eligibility_evidence: Company Description Tabarak Company for Engineering and Construction serves infrastructure, superstructure, real estate investment, and energy service sectors at national and regional levels.
The company has delivered large-scale national projects, demonstrating strong technical capabilities and project execution expertise.
Role Description The Technical Support Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Giza, providing technical assistance to internal teams and external clients.
Ability to work on-site in Giza, manage multiple tasks, and collaborate within multidisciplinary teams.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The company has delivered large-scale national projects, demonstrating strong technical capabilities and project execution expertise. Tabarak focuses on delivering reliable engineering and construction solutions that meet complex project requirements. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Technical Support and Troubleshooting skills to resolve issues efficiently.
